summary: One of three women hiking near Red Deer Lake stepped in deep snow and twisted her ankle in the rocks on June 27; the group spent the night, but the injured hiker could not walk out on June 28; approximately 8-hour rescue by RMRG with Allenspark and Indian Peaks fire, evacuated to the trailhead and transported to urgent care with non-life-threatening injuries.
location: Red Deer Lake, Indian Peaks Wilderness, west of Camp Dick
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Allenspark Fire Protection District; Indian Peaks Fire Protection District
notes: Backfill 2026-09-15: bouldercounty.gov news-archive angle; BCSO release covered in North Denver News.
